narrative.overview:
The site works like a darkroom under a warm safelight: a deep plum dark, cream type, and one peach accent that marks what can be acted on. Inside that room, the work is logged plainly. Releases appear as a list of covers, titles, artists, years and roles. Photographs appear in month groups, divided by thin crop marks. The interface stays quiet so the photographs and record covers carry the page.

Density is low and the scale is generous. Body text is 20px, headings are large and tightly set in a serif, and the layout uses wide gaps instead of boxes, cards or shadows. A sticky sidebar on the left holds the name, the introduction and the navigation; the work fills the wider right column.

This document records the current system. It is descriptive, not a lock: future work may extend it (for example, with a second accent or new surface treatments) when a surface needs it. A full replacement goes through a redesign.
keyCharacteristics: One dark theme only (`color-scheme: dark`), warm and low in contrast between surfaces.
A single accent, Safelight Peach, for links, captions, navigation and controls.
Serif display type (Newsreader) over a sans body (IBM Plex Sans).
Flat, square surfaces. Depth comes from small tonal steps, not shadows.
Darkroom details such as crop marks and a thin tick outline of the page.

rules.name: The Single Safelight Rule
rules.body: Peach is currently the only accent. Text and surfaces use the plum and cream neutrals; colour emphasis comes from peach alone.

rules.name: The Regular-Weight Serif Rule
rules.body: Newsreader is used only at weight 400. Hierarchy comes from size, not weight.

rules.name: The No-Shadow Rule
rules.body: Surfaces are separated by tone and 1px edges, not by shadows or blur.

dos: Do let photographs and covers lead. Keep interface text in the sidebar, captions and credit lines.
Do use Safelight Peach for interactive and supporting text, and Print Cream for content text.
Do set titles in Newsreader at weight 400 with tight line-height (1.02) and -0.04em tracking.
Do separate content with space and 1px tonal lines before adding containers.
Do keep touch targets at least 44px, as the viewer controls and mobile picker do.
Do gate motion behind `prefers-reduced-motion: no-preference` and keep it at or under about 220ms.
donts: Don't add shadows, rounded corners or gradients to extend the current look; they are absent today. Introduce them only as a deliberate change to the system.
Don't add captions to the full photography gallery; it currently shows photographs without visible captions.
Don't add a light theme to a single surface; the site is dark only.
